response.justification: Bogdan is a strong, versatile full-stack/systems engineer with about 15-16 years of experience and genuine entrepreneurial/founder background, but his profile is overwhelmingly generalist web/mobile/backend engineering rather than AI/cloud strategy. There is minimal evidence of AI-specific product building, cloud platform strategy, or advising strategic customers on cutting-edge AI adoption, which are the core requirements of this Director-level AI strategy role.
strengths: 15+ years of diverse engineering experience across web, mobile, embedded, and infrastructure
Demonstrated entrepreneurial drive as founder of GISCollective and long history of side projects/OSS
Strong communication and mentoring track record via talks, workshops, and knowledge-sharing
concerns: Little to no demonstrated AI/ML expertise or AI-powered product development, a core requirement
No evidence of cloud platform strategy work or advising strategic customers/partners at a director level
Career trajectory is IC-focused generalist software development, not strategic/leadership-oriented as required for a Principal/Director-level strategy role

key_factors.factor: No cloud strategy or customer-advisory experience
Extensive broad engineering experience and entrepreneurial mindset
